'''Time's Radiance''' was a zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] ride that was located at [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment park that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
